Completed BO prototype filter standardization session. Created and completed Kanban tasks for BO filter/sort standardization across User Management, Asset Management, Offer Management, Content Management, and Market Data. Updated Prototypes/bo-prototype.html with shared filterCopy/filterOptionSets helpers, normalized shared status/priority/sort/reset labels, fixed Reported Users priority filtering across Thai/English priority values, standardized Asset List status filter options including temporary hidden/permanent hidden/owner deleted cases, aligned Offer status filter to lifecycle order from getOfferStatusMeta(), moved Content article/category filter options to shared option sets, and ordered Market Sync History status options without restoring removed source filters. Protected impact: touched protected User Management, Asset Management, Offer Management, Content Management, and Market Data by explicit task scope; changes were limited to filter/sort/reset wording, option ordering, and filter matching behavior.

Completed BO Dashboard prototype session. Created and completed 2 Kanban tasks: Dashboard spacing/visual breathing room and Dashboard module-flow/mock consistency. Updated Prototypes/bo-prototype.html with Dashboard-only spacing adjustments for metric cards, Work Queue, Recent Activity, lower status cards, panel headers, list rows, and Top Searched Brands; user visually confirmed the updated spacing. Audited Dashboard links and mock examples against navigation/module data, then aligned Offer Activity and Offer Status with Offer Management mock statuses, changed Market Data queue/activity links from missing Import target to Sync History, and updated Recent Activity examples to reference existing mock entities such as OFR-472, Audemars Piguet Royal Oak, and Omega Speedmaster Reduced. Verification: git diff --check passed with LF/CRLF warning only; inline script syntax parsed successfully with Node; custom Dashboard reference check found 41 module/sub references and 0 invalid navigation targets. Browser screenshot QA remained blocked by Chrome headless GPU process crash. Protected impact: touched Dashboard by explicit request; no protected destination module UI/flow was intentionally changed.

Completed BO UI/UX central standard documentation session. Created and completed Kanban task d8e17229-57a7-428a-b756-1fa1755e8dd6 for extracting common design standards from completed protected BO modules: Dashboard, User Management, Asset Management, Offer Management, Content Management, and Market Data. Added BackOffice/BO_UI_UX_STANDARD.md covering source-of-truth rules, protected-screen boundary, page structure, header/breadcrumb, KPI/summary cards, search/filter/sort/reset, list/table/mobile card behavior, status badges, detail pages, modal/confirm flows, forms/editors, navigation context, loading/empty/error states, responsive requirements, module application checklist, QA checklist, and scope boundaries. Verification: git diff --check passed. Protected impact: did not modify Prototypes/bo-prototype.html or protected screens; created documentation only.
